newsitem.title: USA: Fed's overnight system RPs total $1.015 billion.
newsitem.headline: Fed's overnight system RPs total $1.015 billion.

text.p: The Federal Reserve's addition of reserves via overnight system repurchase agreements totaled $1.015 billion on Tuesday, a Fed spokeswoman said.
At 1105 EST/1605 GMT, the overnight bank lending, or federal funds rate, stood below the Fed's 5-1/4-percent target rate at 5-3/16 percent.

Detailing the size of its system repurchase agreements operation is part of the Fed's new daily open market operations announced late last year. The Fed revamped its daily intervention procedure to keep pace with stepped-up market activity. ((-- N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1660))
